The setlist.fm REST API provides read-only access to the world's largest crowd-sourced concert setlist database. Look up artists (by MusicBrainz MBID), setlists and their revision history, venues, cities, and countries, and run full-text search across each. All endpoints are HTTP GET and return either JSON (Accept: application/json) or XML (Accept: application/xml, the default). Every request must include a valid API key in the `x-api-key` header; keys are issued from the setlist.fm API settings page. The API is free for non-commercial use only - commercial use requires contacting setlist.fm. Localized text is available via the `Accept-Language` header (en, es, fr, de, pt, tr, it, pl).
